author: Daniel G Vergel
description:
This article presents the design of a simple password validator that can be configured at compile time by composing independent validation policies.

Compile-Time Policy Composition for Password Validation

by Daniel Gómez Vergel

From the article:

A traditional object-oriented solution could rely on dynamic polymorphism and the Decorator pattern to select and combine validation policies at runtime. In this article, we take a different approach: policy composition is performed entirely at compile time, making the validator configuration part of the type itself.

The example serves as a vehicle for exploring useful C++ techniques, including policy-based design, concepts, and other modern language features such as template for expansions.
title: Compile-Time Policy Composition for Password Validation -- Daniel Gómez Vergel
